tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ snying thig rtsa gsum gtor ma bca' thabs/ rig 'dus bang rim bzhi/ rin chen zur brgyad/ nyi zla/ bla gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa/ dpal chen la bang rim bzhi/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ nyi zla/ yi dam pad 'dab bzhi/ yum bka' la/ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng*/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma pad 'dab bzhi pa/ gsol ka rgyas bsdus ci 'dzoms/ dkar bgegs/ chad brtan/ gsol ka gtor 'bul/ phud bshal gtor ma/ nyin rer tshogs chen po re/ tshogs 'bir brgya re/ ril bu grangs mang bcas so// ༈ 'don dus rig 'dzin dpal chen yum bka' gsum kar/ las byang*/ gsol ka skong bshags/ tshogs/ rdo rje'i thol glu'i/ rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la skyolaḥ rjes lhag ma/ dri med bshags rgyud/ bka' gsang= nam mkha'i= tshogs skong ba/ bde stong= ye shes sku mchog= mkha' 'gro'i smre bshags/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ gzhi thog dang po= dus gsum bde gshegs= 'don res/ bka' gsang= nam mkha'i= tshogs/ bde stong= lhag ma bcas/ tshar bcu tsam song dus rig 'dzin dpal chen gnyis la/ tshogs rdzas 'dod yon= ka dag= sbrel ba gsog yum ka la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ 'og min= gsog dgos/ tshar re bzhin/ mi mgo grang zhing ril bu bzed zhal du 'bul/ do nub/ mdor na= gnam phud man/ rgyun ltar gyi rtsa gsum tshogs 'bum bsags lugs de yin no// (460) ༈ char 'bod 'don 'grigs ni/ sngon 'gro ngag 'don dang*/ yum ka'i bstod pa mthar/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar= sngags stong*/ phyag 'tshal zla ba'i= brgya/ mchod bstod yig brgya/ gsol ka yongs rdzogs sam/ tshe ring ma'i skong ba grangs mang*/ bsnyen pa stong*/ hoḥ phyi ltar tshe ring= sogs sbyar/ sde brgyad gser skyems grangs mang*/ rang gi thugs las= nas/ 'gugs pa brgya/ char phob cig bar dang*/ char bsang*/ klu gtor/ sprin mdo rnams dang*/ rang nyid ye shes= sngags stong*/ gtor 'bul phrin bcol/ na moḥbha ga= brgya/ hūm̐ḥ nā ga ma hā= stong*/ oṃ badzra pa ṇi= man stong*/ bden stobs mtshams su brjod/

char sngags la/ nā ga ta li= sbyar ba stong*/ dgongs 'dus dang*/ sras gcig char sngags stong re/ rlung gnon la/ 'gugs pa brgya'am stong*/ gtor 'bul/ dmigs pa sngags rdzas rnams gang zab spel ba stong tsam/ sprin sdud/ sngags ring stong*/ sngags thung*/ 'bru 'bum bskul rnams gang mang*/ zhi drag phyed ma la/ 'gugs pa brgya/ dmigs pa gong 'og dang sngags rnams stong re/ 'byung ba dgrar lang*/ ci mang*/ de yang thun phyi ma rnams re re bzhin mgor/ gcod yul mkha' 'gro'i gad rgyangs/ bu lon lan chags byang bar shog mthar/ rang rig rang lus dmigs pa= brgya tsamabatang ba dang*/ char chog gzhung la 'jug thun grol dus/ lus gces 'dzin= dang*/ āḥ dge dang mi dge'i= sogs bsngo smon bcas bya/ nub mo spro na tshogs skong dang*/ gsol ka bkyags/ yum ka'i mchod bstod nas bshags pa bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ drag po'i las sbyor rig pas dpyad rjes su phud rabs rgyas pa dang*/ klu gtor lta bu'i mthar/ gshegs gsol rnams sbyar bar bya'o// padma ma ṇis so// dge'o//
